description: SPACERGY: 3D City Model of the Floriade District in Almere, the Netherlands is a model or code deposit deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Daniela Maiullari, P. (Panagiotis) Arapakis. The dataset contains a digital 3D City model of the Floriade district in Almere, the Netherlands. The digital model is encoded in CityGML standard, and includes different CityGML thematic modules: Building, Vegetation, Land_Use and Relief (topography). The model is derived from a masterplan provided by the Urban Design Department, City of Almere in October 2018. Coverage: national (NL); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. Formats: ZIP. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
